title: infermux configuration
description: Configuration for the infermux OpenAI-compatible inference proxy.

apiToken.description: Bearer token required on /v1/*. Empty or omitted = auth disabled.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Per-request deadline in ms (queue + switch + upstream). Default 120000.

healthCheckIntervalMs.description: Health poll interval in ms. Default 500.

healthCheckTimeoutMs.description: Total health polling time in ms before giving up. Default 30000.

coolDownMs.description: GPU cool-down buffer after stopping an engine, in ms. Default 3000.

vramThresholdPct.description: VRAM must drop below this fraction (0..1) before a start; 0 disables the gate. Default 0.15.

vramBackend.description: VRAM source: auto-detect, no-op, or a specific backend. Default auto.

vramCheckTimeoutMs.description: Max time to keep polling VRAM usage in ms. Default 30000.

vramCheckIntervalMs.description: VRAM poll interval in ms. Default 500.

childKillGraceMs.description: SIGTERM -> SIGKILL grace period for child processes, in ms. Default 5000.

stopCommandTimeoutMs.description: Max time to wait for a shell stopCommand, in ms. Default 10000.

provider.description: Provider name; models sharing a provider share one engine instance.

targetBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the provider's OpenAI-compatible API (http:// or https://).

targetModel.description: Model id expected by the provider; the request's model field is rewritten to this.

startCommand.description: Shell command that starts the engine (spawned by the proxy).

stopCommand.description: Shell command that stops the engine.

healthEndpoint.description: Readiness endpoint path (relative to targetBaseUrl) that must return 200.

managed.description: false = engine runs on another host; proxy only health-checks and forwards.

targetApiKey.description: Provider API key sent as Authorization: Bearer. Supports ${ENV_VAR} expansion.

targetHeaders.description: Static headers added to upstream requests (e.g. x-api-key). Values support ${ENV_VAR} expansion.

endpoint.description: Endpoint path (relative to targetBaseUrl) to GET for stats.

vramUsedMiB.description: Dot-separated path into the JSON response for VRAM usage (MiB).

vramTotalMiB.description: Dot-separated path into the JSON response for VRAM total (MiB).
